Default: "REG" value_col Character. Column numeric values. Default: "Value" split_by Character vector. Column(s) create separate maps. Default: NULL variable_col Character. Column variable codes. Default: FALSE Export Settings output_path Character. Directory save maps. Default: NULL export_picture Logical. Export PNG. Default: TRUE export_as_pdf Logical "merged". Export PDF.
